entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Huh!? Whoa, people actually[n]come here by themselves!?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: What do you do at an amusement park[n]by yourself? Doesn't it get lonely?
They're hardcore fans.
It may look like that.
Coming alone isn't bad.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hmmm... Well, I guess it is pretty fun.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...When I first started playing [n]Gun About, I went to different [n]arcades by myself...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But I think this is a little different.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But I bet they're having fun.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hey, I wonder how we look[n]to other people.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: We don't look similar enough to[n]be brothers. And nobody's gonna[n]believe I'm your teacher.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You come here alone too,[n][lName]-san!?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: So, it's that fun of a place, huh...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Is there anything you wanna ride,[n][lName]-san? There's a few[n]I'm curious about.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You sure? Okay, then it's settled!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I wonder if we can ride them all[n]in one day. There are lines, right?[n]We better hurry up!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Um, actually... I've wanted [n]to come here for a long time...!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: They gave me this. It's... something[n]they only give to kids, right?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I'll give you one too, [lName]-san!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I had fun today! Thanks.
